title: Knowledgebase binding: in-repo
description: What adapters/knowledgebase/backends/in-repo.md reads from ak.kb.yaml, applied by `.cursor/bin/ak kb check` after the generic schemas/kb-binding.schema.json has passed. The knowledgebase is a directory of pages committed in the project's own repository, read only, so the locator names a path relative to the project folder and never a machine path, and the directory each kind is read from. The revision read is the merge-base of the checkout's HEAD and the remote's default branch (refs/remotes/origin/HEAD); the binding cannot name another, because a binding a branch commits could name that branch itself (docs/decisions/0010-file-backed-knowledgebase.md, amendment of 2026-11-09). `.cursor/bin/ak kb check` also refuses a kind map in which one directory equals or contains another (kb.binding-invalid), which a schema cannot say.

relative_dir.description: A directory as forward-slash segments relative to where it is read from: no leading slash, no backslash, no segment that is `.`, and no `..` anywhere.
